per_item.label: daily withdrawal cap of 5000

per_item.label: amounts rounded half-up to cents
hits: All amounts are rounded to two decimal places (cents) using Math.round, i.e. half rounds up toward positive infinity, on binary floating-point values.

per_item.label: repeated txn id with a different payload is acknowledged and ignored
hits: A repeated transaction id is acknowledged with ok:true and ignored, without checking that the account, amount or operation type match the original.
Amount validation runs before the duplicate check, so a retry with an invalid amount is rejected even if the id was already processed.

per_item.label: unknown account reads as balance 0 instead of an error
hits: Querying the balance or history of an unknown account returns 0 or an empty list rather than an error.

per_item.label: open() on an existing account is a silent no-op (not an error, not a reset)
hits: Accounts are created implicitly with a zero balance on first use by any operation, including operations that are then rejected.
